rows.rule: One explicitly requested directory is the scan subject; files/missing roots are operational failures. Canonicalize that root once before traversal; an explicit root symlink names the resolved directory.
rows.current: Current metadata follows an explicit root symlink, rejects files/missing roots with exit 1, and retains the supplied spelling.
rows.rationale: One root bounds a static CLI result; canonical identity is separate from presentation.

rows.rule: An explicitly requested root is traversed even when its basename is excluded; exclusions apply only below root.
rows.current: Depth-zero exemption traverses all eight excluded-name roots.
rows.rationale: Explicit user choice must not silently become no_inputs.

rows.rule: Admit only regular-file logical paths with exactly lowercase pm, pl, or t extensions; no content/shebang probe.
rows.current: Only .pm/.pl/.t; upper/mixed case, .cgi/.psgi/.xs/templates and extensionless shebangs omitted.
rows.rationale: Bound the native parser subject to the existing families; widening requires a new policy identity and parser-capability decision.

rows.rule: Skip descendant directory basename local, case sensitively.
rows.current: Skipped at any descendant depth.
rows.rationale: Carton/cpanm dependency trees; explicit dependency root remains possible.

rows.rule: Skip descendant directory basename blib, case sensitively.
rows.current: Skipped at any descendant depth.
rows.rationale: Duplicated Perl build output.

rows.rule: Skip descendant directory basename vendor, case sensitively.
rows.current: Skipped at any descendant depth.
rows.rationale: Vendored dependency source outside the initial own-source report.

rows.rule: Skip descendant directory basename node_modules, case sensitively.
rows.current: Skipped at any descendant depth.
rows.rationale: Dependency/build tree unrelated to native Perl subject.

rows.rule: Skip descendant directory basename .git, case sensitively.
rows.current: Skipped at any descendant depth.
rows.rationale: Version-control metadata.

rows.rule: Skip descendant directory basename target, case sensitively.
rows.current: Skipped at any descendant depth.
rows.rationale: Build output; preserves current finite source selection rationale.

rows.rule: Skip descendant directory basename .build, case sensitively.
rows.current: Skipped at any descendant depth.
rows.rationale: Module::Build output.

rows.rule: Remove auto from the initial canonical exclusion list; traverse ordinary descendant auto directories.
rows.current: Skipped by basename, including lib/auto and user source named auto.
rows.rationale: auto can contain user-owned .pm/.pl/.t source; XS artifacts are already outside admitted extensions. Legacy alias may retain its named compatibility exclusion.

rows.rule: Admit hidden paths except declared exclusions. Do not consult ignore files or spawn Git; do not add workspace-index hidden/cache exclusions implicitly.
rows.current: Hidden source, ignored files and extra workspace-noise names are admitted.
rows.rationale: Stable disk-only subject regardless of Git availability/tracked state; ignored own source must remain visible.

rows.rule: Below the canonical explicit root, do not follow file or directory symlinks. Record an encountered link as skipped_by_policy with stable symlink-refused reason; do not inspect its target.
rows.current: File/directory links, aliases, excluded-target shortcuts and outside-root targets are followed; dangling/ancestor loops are reported.
rows.rationale: Bound traversal to the declared root without importing target/alias semantics. Root symlink is explicitly resolved by root-directory.

rows.rule: No implicit outside-root traversal or descendant link loops. Refused links remain explicit evidence; an external tree needs its own explicit root in a separate invocation.
rows.current: Outside files/directories are selected; ancestry loops become unscanned paths, yet exit may be 0.
rows.rationale: No hidden expansion of project subject; skipping a declared refused link is complete under this policy.

rows.rule: Represent distinct root-relative regular-file paths separately even if device/inode match; avoid cross-platform physical identity deduplication.
rows.current: Two hardlink names are counted twice.
rows.rationale: CLI findings attach to logical paths; physical aliases are not stable portable identity. Symlink aliases are refused separately.

rows.rule: On Linux preserve exact relative component bytes with reversible presentation; sort by raw relative bytes and use / separators. Do not key identity by lossy display, Unicode normalization, or case folding.
rows.current: Supplied root spelling persists; non-UTF-8 names display as U+FFFD and distinct paths can collide.
rows.rationale: An exact selected denominator requires reversible identities. Machine encoding belongs to #11269; no project machine envelope is added here.

rows.rule: Selected file read failure retains a selected, unevaluated subject. Traversal failure retains an operational path with unknown descendant count; mark incomplete. Never infer how many unseen files exist.
rows.current: File read failure counts as blocking; unreadable subtree has an unscanned row outside denominator; percentage may pass.
rows.rationale: Preserve selected/evaluated/unknown separation; #10766 owns canonical exit 2 and legacy compatibility exceptions.

rows.rule: Zero selected files is no_inputs; no percentage or strict-clean claim. A traversal error also marks incomplete.
rows.current: Empty/only-loop/unreadable-root reports can return exit 0.
rows.rationale: Canonical completeness cannot be vacuous; #10766 owns exit mapping and legacy alias compatibility.

rows.rule: Collect a bounded static selection plan and sort paths by exact Linux root-relative bytes before evaluation/projection; sort operational rows by the same identity plus stable reason.
rows.current: No sorting of walker/file findings; creation order can affect rendered error order.
rows.rationale: Deterministic text/machine parity cannot depend on filesystem iteration.

rows.rule: Do not claim an atomic filesystem snapshot. A detected disappearance/replacement/read error remains incomplete with its subject; record read identity/freshness without asserting undetectable races were observed.
rows.current: Selection metadata and read are separate calls; no snapshot/freshness token or race callback.
rows.rationale: #10756 must carry detected movement; parser/evaluation freshness design belongs to that owner. Concurrent race details remain not proven here.

rows.rule: Require a finite internal selection plan: at most 10000 selected paths, 100000 visited entries, depth 128, and 60 seconds discovery elapsed; check cancellation between entries. Any exhaustion/cancellation returns partial evidence and incomplete, never success. No CLI options are implied.
rows.current: No configured discovery cap/callback/deadline; files parsed inline and accumulated findings can grow.
rows.rationale: Conservative initial admission ceilings, not measured capacity guarantees. Entry limits include unsupported files; parser/source-byte admission is a separate required #10756/#10897 decision before canonical completeness.

rows.rule: This receipt qualifies non-root Linux only. Native Windows drive/UNC, macOS case/normalization and permission semantics require independent fixtures before support claims.
rows.current: No native Windows/macOS measurements were performed.
rows.rationale: A Unix path fixture cannot qualify another OS; #10756 and #10792 own follow-up qualification.

rows.rule: One explicit root per invocation in v1. Multiple roots, configured include roots and cross-root identity are out of scope.
rows.current: Current CLI accepts one project directory.
rows.rationale: Avoid importing workspace indexing/include-path policy into a bounded static checker.

rows.rule: Discovery and native parsing must not execute project Perl or modules; no Git or Perl process is needed for the selected set.
rows.current: Native parser/read route plus tested PATH traps and BEGIN marker; exhaustive syscall audit not claimed.
rows.rationale: Real-Perl compatibility belongs to #1780; this decision establishes no installed/release/editor transport proof.

architecture.chosen: Retain CLI-owned static selection in #10756; extract a small policy-driven plan/result boundary without introducing another general scanner or workspace index.

alternatives.assessment: Native, disk-only, exact legacy pm/pl/t and exclusion behavior; inline parsing, unsorted traversal, links and incomplete-success require explicit migration.
alternatives.decision: retain ownership, correct named policy rows through #10756/#10766

alternatives.assessment: Git subprocess and fallback can select different sets; broader case-insensitive source/shebang/XS families, include roots, sorting and cancellation, but ignored paths/traversal errors can vanish; DiscoveryResult lacks operational path evidence and finite entry budget. Does not itself run an index, yet importing its default semantics into CLI changes authority.
alternatives.decision: refuse wholesale reuse for v1; reuse only separately proven pure lower-level primitives without default workspace policy

alternatives.assessment: Pure extension/name predicates exist, but canonical editor families and workspace skip names differ from CLI v1; extensionless path helper reads disk.
alternatives.decision: do not silently reuse wider predicates or content probes; keep explicit versioned CLI policy rows

alternatives.assessment: Could expose finite deterministic error-aware selection, but adds a new generic authority before a second static consumer exists.
alternatives.decision: defer general service; smallest extraction under existing #10756 ownership

migration: #10756 preserves the legacy report under a named compatibility selection identity while carrying explicit incomplete/path/read evidence; no silent legacy behavior switch.
#10756/#10766 implement canonical v1 selection and strict/report completeness deliberately. Correct/refuse rows are future migration obligations, not claims of implemented behavior.
#10897 owns canonical parser evaluation; #10809 owns typed category projection; #11269/#11270 consume the accepted result once, without rewalking/reparsing.
The legacy alias remains text-only under #11270; older #7233 JSON proposal is superseded for projects by the later controller and its current reconciliation comment.
reverse_when: An existing discovery API can produce the same versioned static selection, reversible paths, finite budgets and complete operational evidence without Git/index/default-policy coupling.
Independent native-platform evidence requires a platform-specific path identity or exclusion amendment.
Another real static consumer demonstrates that a generic service removes semantic duplication rather than only shortening code.
